'''Wakemeet''' was a [[Winter/Legends|winter]] holiday among the people of [[Barseg]]. During Wakemeet, Barsegi children dressed as evil spirits and were visited by their neighbors, who offered the children sweets in return for a blessing for the year.

Wakemeet was related to several more somber winter holidays among other [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] that included repentance, offerings to appease [[Demon/Legends|demons]], and the veneration of symbols of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the [[Despot]], known as [[The Devouring]]. Scholars believed for thousands of years that this holiday memorialized a real event, and it was ultimately discovered by [[Bleys Harand]] that the Devouring was a forgotten commemoration of a campaign of genocide waged by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] against the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Kiirium Reaches]].

==Behind the scenes==
The holiday was similar to [[Halloween/Legends|Halloween]].
